article.title: 霸王茶姬九周年為七個海外市場設計在地版Teadore
article.summary: 霸王茶姬在九周年首度把大象角色Teadore帶到海外，並為七個國際市場設計各自的版本。
highlights: 新加坡版本參考魚尾獅，馬來西亞版本採用娘惹服飾及大紅花元素。
品牌保留大象、茶葉形耳朵和品牌字母等識別，讓在地設計仍可辨認。
article.why: 跨市場行銷可預先決定哪些品牌元素要保留，並由當地團隊判斷哪些文化符號合適。
article.next_step: 為下一個區域活動做一頁素材指引，列明核心識別、可調整元素及各市場審核人。
article.detail: 霸王茶姬亞太區行銷主管向Marketing-Interactive表示，Teadore以品牌發源地雲南及茶馬古道為靈感。泰國版本以泰拳裝備呈現，韓國版本穿韓服。品牌將周年活動作為角色首次走進國際市場的機會，並打算讓角色納入長期品牌設計。地方團隊可核對服飾、顏色與象徵符號在不同市場的理解。
article.title_en: CHAGEE localizes anniversary mascot Teadore for seven international markets
article.summary_en: CHAGEE is taking its elephant mascot Teadore overseas for the first time for its ninth anniversary, with local designs for seven international markets.
highlights_en: Singapore's version draws on the Merlion, while Malaysia's uses a kebaya and hibiscus details.
The elephant, leaf-shaped ears and CHAGEE lettermark keep the mascot recognizable across local designs.
article.why_en: Regional teams can decide which brand elements to keep and ask local teams to review cultural references.
article.next_step_en: Create a one-page asset guide for the next regional campaign that lists core identifiers, adaptable elements and market reviewers.
article.detail_en: CHAGEE's APAC marketing chief told Marketing-Interactive that Teadore draws on Yunnan, where the brand started, and the Ancient Tea Horse Road. The Thai version wears Muay Thai gear and the Korean version wears a hanbok. The anniversary is the first overseas outing for a character CHAGEE intends to keep beyond this campaign. Local teams can check how their audiences interpret clothing, colors and symbols.
